note: Gladiator, front, facing the viewer. Grey crested helmet, dark hair at both sides, face and the dark beard are head; beard/hair bottom y~497 (neck skin below it is torso). Maroon pauldrons, grey gorget, belt (buckle y~650-700), the maroon pteruges skirt and the cape/skirt flaps beside the legs are torso; the skirt hangs to y~800, so hip = hem y~800. Left arm (image left) holds a trident upright: the maroon pauldron and the bare skin triangle under it are upper arm (shoulder y~495, elbow x~352 where the leather bracer begins), the bracer and the mauve cuff are forearm (x282-352), the fist (x218-282, y540-634) is hand; the trident (three prongs, base, shaft above and below the fist) is equipment, kept off the fist. Right arm: pauldron is upper arm (shoulder y~497) to the elbow at y~567 where bare skin begins; the bare skin is forearm, wrist y~640 where the leather gauntlet begins; gauntlet is hand to y~706. Legs: the hem (y~800) is the hip; only the bare skin above the grey knee guards is thigh. Knee guards are lower leg (part-cutting.md), so the knees are at the guard tops (left y~803, right y~806); the skin beside the guards, the tan boot cuffs and the boot shafts are lower leg. Boot cuff bands and boot shafts are lower leg; ankles at the instep (left y~888, right y~900).
